cases.excerpt: We identified 1417 cases among black men (209 advanced), and 28,845 among white men (3898 advanced).

comparison.excerpt: Race-specific prostate cancer risk associations were examined among men in the National Institutes of Health (NIH)-AARP Diet and Health Study.

design.excerpt: There are few prospective studies comparing race-specific associations between diet, nutrients, and health-related parameters, and prostate cancer risk.
